description: This file is a CMake module script defining the 'compile_aidl' function used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes licensing information, detailed documentation on how to use 'compile_aidl', and the implementation of the function itself, which handles locating the 'aidl' compiler, setting parameters, and executing the command to generate source files.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to generate source files from AIDL files using the specified aidl compiler, options, and target directory.
